legacy_migration.trigger: A locked original script requires one visually constrained body/object state to be legible before the audience receives the full multi-body room geometry; the object state and any force/permission facts must be script-defined
legacy_migration.directing_decision: Open on the concrete body/object detail, then immediately reveal the complete room container and body distribution before sustained singles; never derive coercion or psychology from the reference picture
legacy_migration.coverage: detail single -> high/elevated room master -> selected face/body singles -> conditional relation resets
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock project-original person_id/seat_id assignments, central route_id, opposing assigned seat/background sides, rear-zone body states and every visible object-state version before the master-to-single progression
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Use the master long enough to read zones and bodies, not the source durations; if an object is removed/changed and that action matters, give it its own visible state transition instead of hiding it in the wide
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK; no dialogue, command, silence, ambience, score or sound-led cut is prescribed
legacy_migration.applicability: Contained multi-body scenes where both an opening physical/object fact and subsequent room accountability are locked-script requirements
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Two-person benign coverage with no multi-body geometry burden; deliberate optical subjectivity; or any scene where the exact removal/contact/permission/force action is itself a required dramatic fact
legacy_migration.failure_mode: The object disappears between scales; the high-to-wide move loses identities or furniture; body count changes; the opening image falsely implies restraint/coercion not present in the script
legacy_migration.counterexample: Same-trigger counterexample UNKNOWN; adjacent different-trigger boundary: UNB-S01E02-C01-APPROACH-TO-CONTAINER-STATE-HANDOFF approaches a container from an exterior and establishes the pair/path/door before the contained state, while this source begins already inside with a detail then room reveal
legacy_migration.unknown: Cloth material/purpose/attachment/removal, who changes it, force, consent, roles, identities, interaction topology, exact camera rig/path, dialogue and sound
legacy_migration.ai_risk: CRITICAL: five-or-more visible bodies at wide scale, face/object continuity, cloth state, room geometry and a large camera reorientation
legacy_migration.fallback: Project-original locked detail -> fixed high master -> fixed eye-level master; add one neutral object-state transition shot only if the locked script requires the action to be seen
legacy_migration.evidence_shots: opening detail S001; high-to-wide room registration S002; first post-master single S003; later room/body refreshes S016, S019, S022, S023
legacy_migration.confidence: HIGH for visible order/geometry; LOW-MEDIUM for transfer until a same-trigger contrary source and locked original script test exist

legacy_migration.directing_decision: Alternate clean A/B singles with selected partial extra-body foreground/depth anchors and restore a room view when the additional body changes zone; identify every cropped body explicitly in the original plan
legacy_migration.coverage: room relation -> clean A or B single -> partial C/D anchored single -> clean counterpart -> room reset after extra-body movement
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock each project-original person_id to an assigned seat/background side or route/zone_id, and lock every rear-zone body state; do not duplicate or silently swap the cropped foreground person
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Cut/reset on locked visible posture, object, route or knowledge changes rather than every spoken line; a partial anchor is conditional, not constant decoration
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK; no listening cue, dialogue cadence, overlap, silence, score or off-screen voice is prescribed

legacy_migration.non_applicability: Only two people are present; the added body has no spatial obligation; optical POV is required; or the third body's action, consent, safety, power or exit must be explicitly visible at that moment
legacy_migration.failure_mode: Foreground identity swaps or duplicates; occlusion hides a required action; accidental proximity implies contact; room side/eyelines drift; a semantically important body vanishes off-frame
legacy_migration.counterexample: Same-trigger counterexample UNKNOWN; adjacent different-trigger boundary: UNB-S01E02-C02-PARTIAL-COMPANION-ANCHOR-IN-CONTAINED-TWO-HANDER uses a partial companion anchor inside a two-person vehicle, while this source adds independently moving C/D and earlier rear bodies with different occlusion and identity risk

legacy_migration.confidence: HIGH for visible extra-body/room recurrence; LOW for semantic/ethical transfer and LOW-MEDIUM for generalization

legacy_migration.trigger: A locked original script defines a late A/B face/body progression as the primary visible state and confirms that additional bodies do not require contemporaneous action, safety, consent, power or exit updates
legacy_migration.directing_decision: After one verified geometry state, progressively remove room/foreground relation anchors, alternate clean tight A/B singles, permit script-timed long holds, and close on the selected body only if the original ending state requires it
legacy_migration.coverage: last verified relation/extra-body state -> clean B/A alternation -> one required third-body check if any -> longer clean singles -> final held single/fade
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock project-original A/B person_id, assigned seat/background side and eyeline-side keys; freeze or explicitly account for C/D/off-frame body states before eliminating relation views
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Durations follow locked visible performance changes, not source timing; long holds require one or more script-defined, camera-visible posture, gaze or, where visible, hand changes plus an explicit endpoint
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK; no dialogue turn, disclosure, pause, breath, silence, score, cue or fade sound is prescribed
legacy_migration.applicability: Contained exchanges whose locked script makes late facial/body progression dominant and makes all additional body states safely non-essential during the hold
legacy_migration.non_applicability: A third person moves, intervenes, exits, grants/refuses consent, changes safety/power, or must be witnessed; active contact; a location/thread interruption requiring re-registration; or a purely optical POV break
legacy_migration.failure_mode: Extra bodies disappear ambiguously; geography collapses; a long hold becomes inert; face/moisture/wardrobe drifts; final fade implies a resolution not in the script
legacy_migration.counterexample: Same-trigger counterexample UNKNOWN; adjacent different-trigger boundary: UNB-S01E02-C03-RE-REGISTER-CONTAINED-GEOMETRY-AFTER-PARALLEL-INSERT re-registers a two-person container after a distinct-location interval, while this source's late S188-S201 run has no distinct-location interval and no room reset
legacy_migration.unknown: Dialogue, emotion, reaction cause, why each hold/cut occurs, C/D/off-frame contemporaneous state, whether the fade resolves anything, score/silence and hidden joins
legacy_migration.ai_risk: HIGH-CRITICAL: long face/performance consistency, moisture/highlight continuity, assigned seat/background states and exact fade endpoint
legacy_migration.fallback: One fixed project-original room master before the late run; two locked A/B singles split into matched performance-state segments; insert one neutral C/D continuity check whenever the script requires that body state
legacy_migration.evidence_shots: clean late run S188-S195; one P-C check S196; held P-B S197; P-A S198; held P-B S199; P-A S200; final held P-B/fade S201
legacy_migration.confidence: HIGH for the visible late coverage/duration pattern; LOW for semantic reason and LOW-MEDIUM for transfer until an original-script test and same-trigger contrary source exist
